description: Irish parliamentary election results 1801-1831, read from the printed pages of Walker (figures and facts only). The source for 1801-1831, checked against Wikipedia.

provenance.method: each page read from the scan (not OCR); page = 0-based index into the private scan
provenance.licence: Figures only. Election results are facts and carry no copyright; the volume is in copyright and is not reproduced.
provenance.gaps: Book page 20 is missing from the scan: the end of the 1807-12 by-elections (after 3 March 1810) and the first two seats of the 1812 general election.
